verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 62.7 (-6.1% in a day) and momentum is 40: prices are falling. 84s cost 700, 85s 2,600 and 86s 5,500. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-24T18:07:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Curtis Jones 86 Thunderstruck after its 28% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 18,750 coins. Now 19,500. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 27.9% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 14 of 23 so far, averaging +6.0% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Alexia Putellas 92 Team of the week after its 48% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 2,494,000 coins. Now 1,150,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 47.6% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 7 of 14 so far, averaging +6.7% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-11-26T07:59:00+00:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,600 (1.24 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,500 (1.34 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,000 (1.27 coins per Item Score point), 88s 13,500 (1.63 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Jérémy Jacquet and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Jérémy Jacquet 77 Rare -51.1%; Lucien Agoumé 76 Rare -47.1%; Ledley King 86 Base Hero -35.5%; Fiamma Benítez 87 Thunderstruck -32.0%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
